title: Storage Layout
desc: Where Studio keeps projects, voices, uploads, and transient data.
lede: Everything Studio writes has a place. Here's the layout.
body:
At a glance
  • Per-project folders for audio, text, output, and trash.
  • Voices and plugin data have their own roots.
  • Transient and trash areas are separate.

Per-project

projects/<id>/
  audio/   text/   m4b/   cover/   trash/

Shared roots

Voices and per-engine plugin data live in their own roots, with transient and trash areas kept apart from durable content. See State: state.json + SQLite.
